scenes.title: The living room, one week later

lines.text: You checked your phone forty times today.
They said they will contact me.
"Dear Adam, thank you for your interest in the Customer Service Agent position. Unfortunately, we have decided to move forward with other candidates. We wish you the best of luck."
I don't want to talk about it.
Adam? You didn't eat dinner. Can I come in?
They rejected me, Mom. Everyone will know I failed. My uncle, the neighbors… everyone.
Listen to me. When one door closes, another door opens. This is not the end. It's only the beginning.
A disaster. I was late, I wore jeans, I said "um" a hundred times, and I answered the wrong question.
She asked about stress. I talked about teamwork.
OK… that's bad. But listen, my first two interviews were a disaster too. Rejection is normal. The problem isn't you. The problem is you weren't prepared.
Meet me tomorrow at the café at six. I'll show you.

choice.q: How does Adam get the news?

options: "When one door closes, another door opens."

choice.q: What does Sami say about his first interviews?

questions.q: What does the email from BlueLine say?
questions.a: It says they decided to move forward with other candidates.

questions.q: Why is Adam worried about his uncle and the neighbors?
questions.a: Because he thinks everyone will know he failed.
She says, "When one door closes, another door opens. This is not the end."

questions.q: What four mistakes did Adam make in the interview?
questions.a: He was late, he wore jeans, he said "um" a lot, and he answered the wrong question.

questions.q: What does Sami say is Adam's real problem?
Tell me about a time something didn't go well for you. What did you learn?
questions.a: Example: I failed my driving test the first time. I learned to practice more.
